intent_summary: Expose causal native historical anomaly evidence through one opt-in forecast call while leaving business materiality, severity and notifications under consumer control.

criteria.criterion: One forecast call reuses its historical analysis and returns typed native signed reference, residual, score, triggers, maturity, calibration support, availability and detector provenance in original input positions; explicit recent-level selection is frozen before calibration, whose residuals and readiness use that selected baseline rather than the current forward fit.

Frozen-origin earlier point evidence and first-detection pattern snapshots survive changed or appended suffixes; provisional evidence cannot trigger, and retrospective screening is separate from anomaly qualification.

Opt-in defaults preserve existing forecast arrays, signed decomposition, horizon prefixes and adjustment semantics; missing gaps and budget failures return unavailable without fabricated or partial evidence.

Public schemas, a single-call compatibility adapter and migration guidance document independent selectors, baseline labels, explicit materiality and version negotiation without changing Guard or saved notifications.
criteria.notes: Schemas, adapter and consumer boundaries are implemented, but the migration guide says the example now pins 0.8.0 while the actual adapter pins 0.9.1; reconcile the current adoption instructions.
